purpose: Turn any useful source into a coherent, personalized learning artifact that helps the reader understand important concepts, tools, systems and practical applications quickly.

priority_areas: new technical concepts with practical leverage

goals: Understand the whole idea rather than collect isolated facts.
Identify concepts and tools that are genuinely worth learning.
Connect new material to existing knowledge and practical work.
Find things that can be tried, adopted, built or monitored.
Know enough about important developments even when no immediate action is required.
Reduce time spent consuming long source material without losing the useful model behind it.

rules: Keep all concepts required to preserve a coherent mental model, even if one prerequisite is not exciting by itself.
Drop repetition, anecdotes and promotional framing that do not change understanding.
Do not force a SAP or enterprise application when another domain is a better fit.
Add missing prerequisites when the source assumes knowledge the reader needs in order to understand the main idea.
Research outside the source when verification, context or comparison materially improves understanding.

explanation_preferences.visual_rule: Every image, diagram or visual block must explain a mechanism, comparison, relationship, sequence or concrete object. Decorative visuals are optional and secondary.

publishing.public_output: reviewed explainer landing pages and machine-readable insight records
